opening.argument: The presenter ties access to a purported early GlobeDX token opportunity to potentially enormous gains and a participation fee. Subscribers are offered entry before the public sale, where he says the biggest gains are, while he describes a possible twenty-six-hundred-fold increase. Participation requires a percentage fee for administering and transferring tokens, with transfer conditional on release. The video also directs viewers to register and submit data for chances to receive an NFT or XBT. Warnings about uncertain outcomes and disclosed commissions qualify the pitch, but do not negate its central mechanism: speculative token appreciation promoted through a fee-based participation flow. That combination establishes the scam case.
